race.comment: RIVENDELL (3) found the front a long way from home then was swamped late to finish a close fourth when resuming over this course and distance last start. Lightly raced four-year-old who should tighten right up following that run and looks the testing material. HARRY'S EVIDENCE (6) started favourite and proved a shade too strong for THE LITTLE GENERAL when fresh from a spell over 1100m at this track last time out. Twice a winner at this distance so going up 150m holds no fears. Up in class but drops 2kgs and is a big chance again. CASTLEJOHN (5) started favourite and just got the cash when resuming over 1100m at Hawkesbury last start. Sparingly raced four-year-old with plenty more to come. THE LITTLE GENERAL (9) will run another bold race on a seven-day back-up. Early favourite PHANTOM MAJOR (8) impressed over 1200m here last time. Thought they might look for something longer than this but still a key runner.
